real_fill_note: Remaining existing global POST budget is 1/100; opening a fill without >=2 POSTs reserved for entry+exit would risk an uncloseable residual position under frozen risk limits. Using non-crossing resting LIMIT order lifecycle instead without expanding budget.

real_order_execution.distinction_note: Trading readiness does not prove new orders were posted or filled; check POST/budget deltas.

trading_readiness.distinction_note: Service liveness (systemd active/PID alive) does not imply trading readiness.
